name: journal
title: Journal
description: A notebook of dated entries. The front page lists posts from their frontmatter, topics are plain pages, and SMGen core writes the RSS feed. No plugins.

demo.tagline: A working notebook, kept in public

features: Entries listed newest first from pages/posts/*.md frontmatter
Topic pages that filter the same list
Months and years as running heads in the margin
RSS feed from SMGen core's RSS_FEEDS
System light and dark with a toggle

sampleContent.purpose: Front page: a short note, then every entry by month
Twelve sample entries across three topics; delete freely
One page per topic; add a file to add a topic
About page; says the notebook is a demo

notes: RSS_FEEDS.posts.title and description in .smgen.yaml keep the sample text until you edit them
A post needs title, description, description-meta, date, topic and feeds: [posts] in its frontmatter
